native.query: SELECT seller_id, seller_state, seller_city, time_period, order_volume, total_freight_value, freight_ratio FROM mart_seller_freight WHERE 1=1 [[AND {{month}}]] [[AND {{seller_id}}]] ORDER BY freight_ratio DESC
